theorems.name: Submission.pcoarea_chart_integrand_tonelli
theorems.statement: ∀ (m k N : ℕ) (ψ : Rn (m + k) → Rn N) (Φ : OpenPartialHomeomorph (Rn (m + k)) (WithLp 2 (Rn m × Rn k))), ContinuousOn ψ Φ.source → ∀ B ⊆ Φ.source, MeasurableSet B → ∀ φ : Rn N → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable φ → Measurable (fun y : Rn m ↦ ∫⁻ z : Rn k, (Φ '' B).indicator (fun w ↦ φ (ψ (Φ.symm w)) * ENNReal.ofReal (((fderiv ℝ (ψ ∘ Φ.symm) w).comp ((WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (Rn m) (Rn k)).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (Rn m) (Rn k)))).toLinearMap.normDet)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (y, z))) ∧ ∫⁻ w, (Φ '' B).indicator (fun w ↦ φ (ψ (Φ.symm w)) * ENNReal.ofReal (((fderiv ℝ (ψ ∘ Φ.symm) w).comp ((WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (Rn m) (Rn k)).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (Rn m) (Rn k)))).toLinearMap.normDet)) w = ∫⁻ y : Rn m, ∫⁻ z : Rn k, (Φ '' B).indicator (fun w ↦ φ (ψ (Φ.symm w)) * ENNReal.ofReal (((fderiv ℝ (ψ ∘ Φ.symm) w).comp ((WithLp.prodContinuousLinearEquiv 2 ℝ (Rn m) (Rn k)).symm.toContinuousLinearMap.comp (ContinuousLinearMap.inr ℝ (Rn m) (Rn k)))).toLinearMap.normDet)) (WithLp.toLp 2 (y, z))
